crossRefs.note: Now while the bridegroom delayed, they all slumbered and slept.
But if that evil servant should say in his heart, ‘My lord is delaying his coming,’
Therefore the Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king, who wanted to reconcile accounts with his servants.
When he had begun to reconcile, one was brought to him who owed him ten thousand talents.
He also said to his disciples, “There was a certain rich man who had a manager. An accusation was made to him that this…
He called him, and said to him, ‘What is this that I hear about you? Give an accounting of your management, for you can…
“Now there was a certain rich man, and he was clothed in purple and fine linen, living in luxury every day.
For none of us lives to himself, and none dies to himself.
But if anyone builds on the foundation with gold, silver, costly stones, wood, hay, or stubble,
For we must all be revealed before the judgment seat of Christ that each one may receive the things in the body…
Let not many of you be teachers, my brothers, knowing that we will receive heavier judgment.

translations.web: “Now after a long time the lord of those servants came, and reconciled accounts with them.
translations.bsb: After a long time the master of those servants returned and settled accounts with them.
translations.kjv: After a long time the lord of those servants cometh, and reckoneth with them.
translations.asv: Now after a long time the lord of those servants cometh, and maketh a reckoning with them.
